articles.title: Brittany Mahomes reveals how Meghan Markle inspired her dramatic wardrobe transformation and growing love for polished fashion

articles.body: Brittany Mahomes has never been afraid to make a statement with her fashion choices, whether she is cheering for the Kansas City Chiefs or attending a high-profile event. However, one unexpected source reportedly helped shape her changing wardrobe. Meghan Markle's work on the hit legal drama Suits may have influenced Brittany's growing interest in polished, professional outfits. The connection came to light in 2025, when Brittany revealed that binge-watching the show had changed the way she approached fashion. It offered an interesting glimpse into the inspiration behind her evolving personal style.How Meghan Markle's role in Suits inspired Brittany Mahomes' styleBrittany revealed her fashion inspiration during a pre-show Instagram video for The Kelly Clarkson Show in January 2024. When asked about the television series she had been watching, Patrick Mahomes' wife named Suits.Her interest went beyond the show's legal drama and complicated relationships. Brittany explained that the wardrobe choices had influenced her own shopping habits and encouraged her to rethink her everyday outfits."It has inspired me to completely change my wardrobe," she said.Although Brittany did not directly credit Meghan Markle for the transformation, the actress played Rachel Zane in the popular series. Her character became known for a sophisticated wardrobe filled with tailored pieces, elegant dresses and smart office looks.Brittany's outfit in the Instagram video also reflected that influence. She wore a black blazer with a matching blouse and black leather trousers, creating a sleek combination that would not have looked out of place in Rachel's wardrobe.The revelation offered a different look at how celebrity fashion inspiration works. Sometimes, a television character can influence personal style just as much as a designer collection or a red-carpet appearance.Brittany Mahomes embraces Meghan Markle-inspired business fashionBrittany's wardrobe choices throughout 2024 also showed her growing interest in structured, business-inspired outfits. While her game-day fashion often features bold colours and custom Kansas City Chiefs pieces, her off-field looks have explored a more polished direction.One standout example came in November 2024, when she shared an Instagram photo wearing a red shacket with black leather boots. Oversized sunglasses and a Louis Vuitton handbag completed the confident look.She also wore a blazer-inspired outfit during a September 2024 game day, pairing it with black Chanel penny loafers. The ensemble highlighted her interest in combining classic tailoring with modern fashion.Meghan's own style offered plenty of inspiration for this direction. Her tailored pantsuit at the 2025 TIME100 Summit demonstrated how structured clothing can balance feminine details with a more powerful silhouette.Brittany has continued to experiment with different looks rather than sticking to one fashion identity. However, her interest in Suits showed that even an unexpected television influence could help shape a celebrity's wardrobe.For the Chiefs star's wife, the shift towards sharper silhouettes and business-inspired pieces added another dimension to her already recognisable fashion choices.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Vikings coach sends message after Lions’ Jack Campbell suffers scary injury
articles.summary: The linebacker left the field on a stretcher after colliding with a teammate trying to make a tackle.
articles.body:
Minnesota Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell sent a heartfelt message to Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell, who was carted off the field with a scary injury in their game Sunday, Nov. 1.

The Lions' Pro Bowl linebacker was taken off the field on a stretcher during the Week 8 game after he was hurt while trying to tackle T.J. Hockenson.

"We're all thinking and praying for Jack Campbell," O'Connell said after the game. "I asked Dan after the game if he had any update. He didn't have much of one, but it's definitely something that you hate seeing.

"Still hard to talk about the result when you see something like that."

Campbell and defensive end Eric O'Neill both hit Hockenson at the same time and Campbell appeared to get bent backwards as he fell to the ground. Campbell was motionless on the field as he was attended to.

In his own postgame remarks, the Lions' head coach, Dan Campbell, said Jack Campbell "is being taken care of. We don't have any new information. We'll keep you updated as this goes." MORE: Former Raiders running back, Super Bowl champion, dies

Another Lions linebacker, Derrick Barnes, was also unaware of his teammate's condition when he spoke to reporters after the game.

"I don't know even know what's going on, but I'm going to be there to support him," Barnes said. "When you see your brother go down like that, there's a fire that gets lit … that says it's time to go, really."
